title: RenderSettings
description: Mirrors hayro::RenderSettings; not all settings are supported. This is documentation, kept in sync by hand with the RenderSettingsJson struct, and not used at runtime.

force_image_interpolation.description: true draws every image with bilinear interpolation, whatever the PDF asks for. Absent follows hayro's default (read from RenderSettings::default()).

aliasing_threshold.description: If set, anti-aliasing is disabled and a pixel is painted only when its coverage exceeds this value. Absent (hayro's default) keeps anti-aliasing on.

hinting.description: Whether text should be hinted. Absent follows hayro's default (read from RenderSettings::default()).

glyph_caching.description: Whether rasterized glyphs should be cached and reused. Absent follows hayro's default (read from RenderSettings::default()).
